digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and ticket store convergence
propositions: The review-bot persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume is not refreshed during redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, leaving divergent history.
The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block but the script does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset a divergent persistent clone to enable self-convergence.
The autodeploy.sh script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing deploy delivery of scripts-only changes to the ensure script.
The convergence mechanism must remain best-effort and never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote, requiring defensive handling when credentials are absent or origin is unreachable.

A narrow adoption path must reset the pre-epoch local tickets branch to a newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when preconditions prove no local-only commits exist, while preserving exact local tip in all divergent or ambiguous cases.
